llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must create the root navigator with `createDrawerNavigator` from `@react-navigation/drawer`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createDrawerNavigator is imported from @react-navigation/drawer and called to produce Drawer.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must register both `Account` and `Help` as drawer screen routes in the drawer navigator config.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both Account and Help screens are registered as Drawer.Screen children with matching name props.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must build navigation from the drawer tree via `createStaticNavigation(...)` and render that navigation component from `App`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createStaticNavigation receives JSX (dynamic API) instead of a static navigator config object, so the static navigation component is not correctly constructed. Additionally, App wraps it in NavigationContainer, which the static API does not require and is incompatible with.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The static API requires passing a plain config object (e.g., Drawer.Navigator with screens defined via a screens property object) to createStaticNavigation, not JSX elements. Passing JSX is the dynamic API pattern, not the static API pattern.
